en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a street with a long, two‑story building featuring arched windows on the ground floor and rectangular windows above. Leafless trees line the sidewalk and cast shadows on the facade. A tall fence and an old street lamp stand on the left. On the right, a wooden gate and fence bear a sign for a restaurant. Printed red lettering at the top identifies the place as a restaurant named Glashütte in Radeburg, and another signboard near the gate repeats the restaurant name along with the proprietor's name.
